preview.title: Try it: motor start and stop
preview.subtitle: The classic seal-in circuit. Press START and STOP and watch power flow through the rung.
preview.explanation: The motor contact, in parallel with START, keeps the circuit closed after you release the button: that is the seal-in (latch). STOP uses a normally closed contact, which opens when pressed and breaks the circuit.
